jobs_results.title: Experienced Cloud Security Engineer (m/f/d) - Cybersecurity
jobs_results.description:
Your Tasks

The cloud security engineer (m/f/d) performs various functions, including being responsible for the overall implementation of security cloud solutions and supports the MMS product teams in their cloud implementations.

You would help to improve and develop new designs and security strategies across all types of cloud-based applications (including infrastructure, platform, and software as a service).
• Responsible for the thorough documentations of implementations, via technical documentation and run-books
• Apply adept understanding and experience with systems automation platforms and technologies
• Execute security architectures for cloud/hybrid systems, including providing subject matter expertise to other IT and business teams
• Partake in efforts that shape the organization’s security policies and standards for use in cloud environments as well as hardening measures
• Support cross-functional teams in implementing Cyber Security cloud controls and collaborate with MMS... product teams to address complex technology challenges during the cloud transition
• Responsible for automating security controls, data and processes to provide improved metrics and operational support
• Spot and execute new security technologies and best practices into the company’s Cloud offerings

Your Profile
• Strong interest and knowledge in cyber security technologies (several years of professional experience desirable)
• A strong technical and business understanding of endpoint tools and methodologies for securing cloud environment
• Expert knowledge on cloud technologies, diagrams and troubleshooting
• Degree in Computer Science or related degree preferred
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills

About Us

MediaMarktSaturn Technology is working to make Europe’s number-one consumer electronics retailer the technology leader in its industry. To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 13 countries.

Additional Benefits
• Young environment, where not everything is written in stone, and where you are expected to contribute and co-create the culture of the Tech Hub and international collaboration model.
• You'll have a 10% discount on the entire MediaMarkt website, so you can treat yourself at a lower price whenever you want!
• On top of your compensation package, you can request Flexible Pay “MediaFlex program” (a.e. Ticket Restaurant, Private Health Insurance with DKV, …)
• Flexible working time and possibility to combine home office / presential working. Intensive workday every Friday and during summer.
• The possibility to choose between 2 offices: The first one is the MediaMarkt Iberia HQ with a very attractive menu at a price. You'll eat for less than €4! And the second office is located at Pier01, in Barceloneta, right in the center of Barcelona. Free coffee and free fruit once a week.
• If you need a VISA, don't worry, we'll assist you with the visa process and accompany you throughout the entire process!
• There is a training budget so you can continue developing the skills you need most to keep growing professionally and personally!
• We offer language classes: English, Spanish, and German.
• On your birthday, you won't work! It's a day for you to enjoy without thinking about work.
• You'll be working with the most cutting-edge technological stack of the moment.

Job Infos

Media Markt Saturn Th Services Barcelona

Department: HQ - IT

Entrylevel: Professional Level

Type of Employement: Full Time

Working Hours: 40

jobs_results.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are in search of a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Security Engineer with a minimum of 5 years in the field of security, emphasizing a robust focus on cloud security. The ideal candidate should possess a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience specifically in AWS cloud security.

Responsibilities:
• Cloud Security Leadership:
• Demonstrate a proven ability to build and implement comprehensive cloud security programs from the ground up.
• Compliance Expertise:
• Ensure adherence to recognized cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST, ISO, and IASME.
• Technical Proficiency:
• Utilize expertise in a broad range of security tools and technologies, including IAM, WAFs, SIEM, vulnerability scanners, firewall management, and encryption technologies.
• Scripting/Coding:
• Showcase a strong command of at least one scripting or coding language for automation and customization purposes.
• Threat Modeling:
• Apply familiarity with threat modeling techniques, including DREAD or SDL, to... enhance security measures.

Requirements:
• Minimum 5 years of overall experience in the security domain.
• Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in AWS cloud security.
• Proven track record of building and implementing cloud security programs.
• Solid understanding of recognized cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST, ISO, and IASME.
• Experience with a variety of security tools and technologies, including IAM, WAFs, SIEM, vulnerability scanners, firewall management, and encryption technologies.
• Strong expertise in one scripting or coding language.
• Familiarity with threat modeling techniques such as DREAD or SDL.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

If you are a dynamic and experienced professional ready to contribute to the cutting-edge field of cloud security, we invite you to apply

jobs_results.title: Cloud Cyber Security specialist (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Siemens Healthineers is a place for people who dedicate their energy and passion to this greater cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment where you have the space to stretch beyond your comfort zone to grow personally and professionally. Sound interesting?

Then come in and join our team as Cloud Cyber Security specialist!

Your mission and responsibilities:

This is a role well suited to an ambitious professional, looking for the next step in their career. As a Cloud Cyber Security specialist, you will have responsibility for the definition and implementation for the cyber security designs within Siemens Healthineers.

Task and responsibilities:

Your main tasks and goals are:
• You will support the development of the cloud security strategy.
• You will consult on topics related to cyber... security in cloud environments.
• You will participate in the design of secure reference architectures for our business.
• You will define processes to enforce the cyber security standards for managed accounts and deployed services in the cloud.
• You will take care of the selection and deployment of monitoring technologies to proactively detect security anomalies and potential incidents.

Qualifications:
• You have proven practical experience on SecDevOps for cloud environments and technologies such as:
• Container security: AWS ECS, AWS EKS, ACI, AKS, Kubernetes or Docker.
• Ansible, Terraform, Cloud formation or ARM templates.
• Azure Pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins or Gitlab-ci.
• AWS lambda or Azure functions.
• Firewalls/NSG, load balancers, AWS, Azure and GCP security tools.
• Bachelor’s degree in the field of computer science, industrial engineering or similar, preferably with a focus on information security.
• You have practical knowledge about Azure and AWS (GCP knowledge will be positively valued).
• 3 years of experience in cyber security, for which at least two of them are related to cloud.
• Certifications as cloud security specialist or architect would be of advantage (such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Security Specialist, AZ-304T00-A, AZ-303T00-A or AZ-500). Other security certifications will be positively valued.
• You have proven experience implementing secure architectures/solutions in cloud environments.
• You have proven experience working with vulnerability detection and remediation technologies for cloud environments.
• You have experience analysing and implementing security good practices based on common frameworks.
• You enjoy engaging with different teams and facilitating technical discussions to find solutions.

Being part of our team: Our global team: Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 55,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Curious about our culture? Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That’s why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.

As an equal-opportunity employer we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities.

La diversidad en Siemens Healthineers es nuestra fuente de creatividad e innovación. Estamos plenamente comprometidos con el principio de igualdad de trato y de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres. Contar con diferentes tipos de talento -independientemente de su raza, religión, género, orientación sexual, edad, discapacidad o cualquier otra característica indicada en la legislación vigente- nos hace ser más competitivos y estar mejor preparados para responder con éxito a las demandas de la sociedad

jobs_results.title: Staff Engineer, RBI Cloud Infrastructure
jobs_results.description:
About Netskope

Today, there's more data and users outside the enterprise than inside, causing the network perimeter as we know it to dissolve. We realized a new perimeter was needed, one that is built in the cloud and follows and protects data wherever it goes, so we started Netskope to redefine Cloud, Network and Data Security.

Since 2012, we have built the market-leading cloud security company and an award-winning culture powered by hundreds of employees spread across offices in Santa Clara, St. Louis, Bangalore, London, Melbourne, Taipei, and Tokyo. Our core values are openness, honesty, and transparency, and we purposely developed our open desk layouts and large meeting spaces to support and promote partnerships, collaboration, and teamwork. From catered lunches and office celebrations to employee recognition events (pre and hopefully post-Covid) and social professional groups such as the Awesome Women of Netskope (AWON), we strive to keep work fun, supportive and interactive... Visit us at Netskope Careers. Please follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter@Netskope.

About The Role

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.

The RBI Team develops the Netskope Remote Browser Isolation (RBI) service. RBI isolates uncategorized and risky websites for our Next Gen Secure Web Gateway (SWG) and Security Service Edge (SSE) solutions. Known safe sites are allowed, known bad sites are blocked, and risky websites are isolated for safe viewing all within one cloud platform, one console, and one policy engine.

What’s In It For You

As a member of the RBI team you will work cross-functionally to build and scale the cloud-native RBI platform. You will be solving challenging problems in distributed systems at large scale: performance and scalability, high availability, containerization, monitoring, visibility and analytics. You will also be exposed to advanced Web technologies, such as Chromium Embedded Frameworks, WebGL and WebRTC.

What You Will Be Doing
• Building software to provide a scalable framework supporting enablement and rapid deployment of distributed applications and services in a microservice architecture.
• Working with product managers to define the product, working with architects for high-level and detailed architecture design, and coordinating with other teams to complete the solution.
• Ensuring product resiliency and sustainability.
• Coaching, mentoring and encouraging the growth and career progression of team members.
• Establishing best practices and code hygiene in software development.

Required Skills And Experience
• Minimum 10 + years of work experience
• Architectural experience with building frameworks for rapid deployment and expansion
• Strong design skills and system design experience in a linux environment
• Experience in multi-threaded, multi-component complex systems
• Good understanding of data structures and algorithms.
• Good understanding of distributed systems and networking technologies.
• Strong Programming knowledge of one of the following: Go, C/ C++, Java
• Ability to suggest coding best practices and bring in effective code review feedback.
• Flexible in coordinating with global teams and encouraging round-the-clock efficiency.
• Ability to coach, mentor and encourage growth and career progress of team members.

Additional Skills
• Strong verbal and written communication skills. Communicate in an open, transparent and consistent manner with team and co-workers.
• Determined and ever ready to roll up sleeves to respond to the needs of customers proactively and promptly.
• Achievement oriented and willing to take responsibility for their own actions.
• Believe in innovation and out-of-the box thinking to foster originality of ideas
• Experience in Kubernetes and building software using CNCF components and hand-on experience with CI-CD tools managing deployment at cloud scale(preferred).
• Past experience working with international teams from different countries/cultures is preferred.
• Knowledge and experience with remote browser isolation, Chrome Embedded Framework, Service orchestration in AWS or GCP, VDI or video streaming is a big plus.

Education
• B.S/M.S. degree from a recognized and accredited university/college

Netskope is committed to implementing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. Netskope does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on religion, race, color, sex, marital or veteran statues, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, genetic information, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations of any jurisdiction in which we operate.

Netskope respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us, please refer to Netskope's Privacy Policy for more details

jobs_results.title: Senior Cloud Engineer.
jobs_results.description:
Stimulating. Motivating. Challenging.

Leveraging its long-standing expertise in securing digital content as well as fighting piracy, Kudelski Security, a division of the Kudelski Group, is a provider of cybersecurity solutions and services focused on protecting data, processes and systems for companies and organizations around the world, safeguarding their assets at a time of increasingly remote communications.

Reference : 14191

Publication Date : 07-12-2023

Senior Cloud Engineer.

Location : Madrid, Spain

Mission

Stimulating. Motivating. Challenging.

Kudelski Security, a division of the Kudelski Group (SIX: KUD.S), is an innovative, independent Swiss provider of tailored cyber and media security solutions to enterprises and public sector institutions.

Our team of security experts delivers end-to-end consulting, technology, managed services, and threat intelligence to help organizations build and run successful security programs.

Our global reach and cyber solutions focus is... reinforced by key international partnerships.

Kudelski Security is jointly headquartered in the United States and Switzerland. For more information, please visit: www.kudelskisecurity.com

Your Mission

As part of our Infrastructure Engineering team, your mission will be to design, build and maintain highly available and resilient cloud infrastructures that supports Kudelski Security’s business. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working in a high-paced, and highly technical environment, is security-minded, familiar with the DevOps culture of “you build it, you run it” and the open-source world.

If you:
• Are passionate about cloud infrastructures and automation.
• Are at ease in a fast-paced environment and able to get out of your comfort zone.
• Are willing to grow your skillset and learn new technologies.

This position could be for you.

Responsibilities
• Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructures and services, as code.
• Work on continuous integration & deployment to deploy the infrastructure and its components.
• Suggest and initiate improvements related to quality, scalability, reliability, and availability of existing workloads, to better support our stakeholders.
• Actively contribute to creating and updating architecture diagrams and documentation.
• Participate to security related initiatives, threat modeling exercises, and certifications (e.g., ISO & SOC2).
• Advise on cost-efficiency and ways to optimize spendings.
• Resolve technical issues, provide hands-on assistance to stakeholders on a wide variety of technical topics, support the whole stack 24/7.

Requirements / Profile

This role involves:
• Contacts with people running the business, developers, and data engineers.
• Working in a multicultural environment, the team is spread between India, Spain, Switzerland, and the United States.
• Coaching, sharing knowledge and experience with less experienced colleagues.

jobs_results.title: Technical Security Manager - TSSL
jobs_results.description:
¿Te gustaría ser un "Superhéroe de la Nube"?

Buscamos profesionales que quieran desarrollar los últimos "superpoderes" en nuestras tres áreas tecnológicas clave para dar respuesta a los retos digitales de nuestros clientes: Adopción Cloud, Experiencia Digital y Ciberseguridad en una de las compañías tecnológicas líderes del mercado.

Evolutio nace después de más de 30 años prestando servicios en el mercado español con la marca BT (British Telecom) con una nueva visión: ser el socio de confianza que acompaña a las empresas en el proceso de Transformación asociado a la adopción de las tecnologías Cloud.

Monitorizamos, analizamos y respondemos a las amenazas a usuarios y activos (datos), apoyándonos en las mejores tecnologías, fuentes de inteligencia y técnicas de AI y ML. Conocemos los retos a los que nuestros clientes se enfrentan y cómo la tecnología les puede ayudar.

¡Sólo nos faltas tú!

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un Technical Security Manager (TSSL) cuya principal responsabilidad... será maximizar la experiencia de cliente con los servicios gestionados de ciberseguridad prestados por Evolutio, acompañando a los clientes en la evolución y optimización de los servicios.

Funciones:

· Punto de contacto principal para el cliente en la Gestión de Servicios del CiSOC.

· Responsable del seguimiento de la evolución del Inlife del servicio (QBRs, Dashboards, Generación de informes).

· Responsable de la definición del modelo de relación con el cliente (Handbook).

· Responsable del cumplimiento de SLAs/SLOs acordados con cliente.

· Responsable de la optimización del servicio, adaptándolo a las necesidades específicas del cliente

· Responsable de la evolución del servicio, identificando de forma proactiva nuevas necesidades y oportunidades de negocio.

· Representante de los intereses de cliente en los foros internos de la compañía, para servicios de CiSOC, en coordinación con otros equipos y Roles de la compañía.

· Responsable del seguimiento de la operación del servicio con el equipo de CiSOC.

· Supervisión de la rentabilidad de la cuenta para servicios de CiSOC (seguimiento de imputación de costes y análisis de esfuerzo)

· Supervisión de la entrega de nuevos proyectos en cliente, gestionando la experiencia de cliente.

Consideramos imprescindible:

· Gran expertise técnico en servicios de ciberseguridad analítica y operativa (Threat Monitoring, Waf, EDR, XDR, CASB, Mail protection, Proxy web, Gestión de vulnerabilidades, Threat Intel, otros).

· Amplio Conocimiento y experiencia en tecnologías de principales fabricantes (IBM-Qradar, Microsoft, Cortex-PA, Cisco-CES, TrendMicro-XDR, Crowdstrike, McAfee-CASB, otros)

· Habilidades de gestión y comunicación con cliente.

· Capacidad de liderazgo y presentación de planes de mejora, planes e informes de servicio e informes de incidentes.

· Visión estratégica global del sector de ciberseguridad.

· Actitud proactiva y constructiva.

· Gran capacidad de trabajo en equipo.

· Experiencia mínima de 5 años en entornos de operación de ciberseguridad (SOCs)

· Experiencia mínima de 1 año como especialista en servicios de ciberseguridad (L3)

· Experiencia en gestión de servicios de ciberseguridad con cliente

· Disponibilidad de trabajo en hibrido con visitas concertadas con clientes.

Consideramos deseable:

· Experiencia en gestión de proyectos.

· Experiencia en marco regulatorio y Compliance (ISO27K, ENS)

· Certificación CISM

· Certificación CISSP

¿Qué ofrecemos?

🏡 Teletrabajo y oficina. Tú decides cómo y cuándo teletrabajar, llegando a un equilibrio con tu equipo.

🥳 Concilia tu vida laboral y personal. Tendrás flexibilidad horaria y jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año y durante julio y agosto.

👨🎓 Quieres certificarte? Apúntate a nuestro amplio catálogo de certificaciones! Te pagamos la formación y el examen y si apruebas, te damos una recompensa económica. Además, tendrás acceso a MyAcademy, nuestra plataforma de formación continua.

🎁 Disfruta de nuestros beneficios sociales gratuitos: servicio médico, seguro de vida y accidentes, plan de pensiones, etc.

🌟 Benefíciate de nuestro plan de retribución flexible: tickets restaurante, seguro médico para familiares, abono transporte, cheque guardería y formación.

✈️️ Tendrás 23 días laborables de vacaciones + 24 y 31 de diciembre + 1 día extra cada 3 años.

️💰 Recomienda a tus amigos a nuestras vacantes. Participa en nuestro programa de referenciados y consigue tu gratificación.

🍏 Venir a la oficina tiene infinitas ventajas, entre ellas, te invitamos a un buen café con tus compis y fruta fresca.

🚀 Apostamos por tu crecimiento profesional, desarrolla tu plan de carrera o muévete a otros departamentos

jobs_results.title: (Senior) Cloud Security Engineer - based in Luxembourg
jobs_results.description:
This position is based at our Luxembourg headquarters and requires regular office presence. The EIB offers you the opportunity to live and work in a truly international and multi-cultural environment. We also offer relocation support.

The EIB, the European Union's bank, is seeking to recruit for its Group Corporate Services Directorate – Group Digital Office (GCS-GDO), Cybersecurity Division (CD), IT Security Unit (SEC) at its headquarters in Luxembourg a (Senior) Cloud Security Engineer*.

This is a full-time position at grade 5/6 for which the EIB offers a permanent contract.
• internal benchmark (Senior) Engineer IT Technology & Infrastructure

Purpose

Are you passionate about staying ahead of ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape?

Bring your career to the next level with us at the EIB, where innovation meets security in the cloud! Join our dynamic team and play a pivotal role in crafting cutting-edge security architectures for cloud and hybrid environments. With us, you'll... collaborate closely with top-tier IT security professionals, enterprise architects, and cloud experts to ensure seamless integration of security controls, enhancing monitoring, resilience, and regulatory compliance across all IT systems.

Operating Network

We’re searching for an engineer with a drive who will accompany the EIB Group in its digital transformation journey.

You will report to the Head of the IT Security Unit.

Accountabilities
• Collaborate with IT security, architects, and cloud experts in developing secure cloud and hybrid environments, preparing cutting-edge security architectures
• Utilize top tools like AWS Shield and Azure Firewall, becoming a cloud security expert by protecting our environments and guiding third-party security integrations
• Define and implement security standards in partnership with Cloud Operations and Cloud Center of Excellence teams, ensuring their effective application across our cloud environments
• Create detailed documentation and diagrams for security architectures and operational processes, developing comprehensive security documentation
• Provide cybersecurity solutions to support our engineering teams, enhancing the security of EIBG's IT environment
• Align with business needs and risk appetite while building strong business relationships and proposing applicable industry developments
• Integrate IT security controls into our Risk Management and Crisis Management processes, leading in information security governance
• Advise on cybersecurity management, guiding our cybersecurity strategy to align with organizational goals and risk tolerance
• Take the lead in monitoring and responding to security incidents in our cloud environments, ensuring swift detection and response
• Assist in organizing response and recovery during incidents as part of our incident response efforts, ensuring business continuity

Qualifications
• University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor), preferably in relation to risk management, IT or information management
• Minimum 5 years relevant experience with proven track record of success in IT security implementation, or IT security operations
• Experience in IT cloud security operations with public cloud provides preferably AWS or Azure
• Experience in running major security-related projects
• Knowledge of ISO/IEC27000 standard series
• Knowledge of security architecture, including cloud environments, endpoint protection, operating systems, strong authentication solutions, web security
• Experience in running major security-related projects
• Knowledge sharing skills, including presentations and conducting workshops, drafting of documentation
• Excellent knowledge of English and/or French (*), with a good command of the other. Knowledge of other EU languages would be an advantage.

Competencies

Find out more about EIB core competencies here

(*) Unless stated explicitly as a required qualification, a good command of French is not a pre-requisite for hire. As both English and French are however official working languages of the EIB, proficiency in both languages is a pre-requisite for your future career development. Any language clause in your contract must be fulfilled in order for you to be eligible for a promotion (either via the annual appraisal cycle or via an internal selection process). Proficiency is understood to mean the attainment of level 5 of the Inter Institutional language courses, corresponding to B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL). The Bank offers appropriate training support.

We are an equal opportunities employer, who believes that diversity is good for our people and our business. We encourage all suitably qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation/identity, disability or neurodiversity.

Applicants with specific needs are encouraged to request reasonable accommodations at any stage during the recruitment process. Please contact the EIB Recruitment team Jobs@eib.org who will ensure that your request is handled.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group. In case of selection for the position you agree to comply with all measures (policies, controls, document classification and management) implemented by the EIB Group to prevent unauthorised disclosure of any information or any damage to the EIB Group reputation.

Deadline for applications:This is an open campaign to consecutively fill open positions. The campaign will remain open until the positions are filled. Applications will be reviewed in order of receipt

• Take the lead in monitoring and responding to security incidents in our cloud environments, ensuring swift detection and response
• Assist in organizing response and recovery during incidents as part of our incident response efforts, ensuring business continuity

Qualifications
• University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor), preferably in relation to risk management, IT or information management
• Minimum 5 years relevant experience with proven track record of success in IT security implementation, or IT security operations
• Experience in IT cloud security operations with public cloud provides preferably AWS or Azure
• Experience in running major security-related projects
• Knowledge of ISO/IEC27000 standard series
• Knowledge of security architecture, including cloud environments, endpoint protection, operating systems, strong authentication solutions, web security
• Experience in running major security-related projects
• Knowledge sharing skills, including presentations and conducting workshops, drafting of documentation
• Excellent knowledge of English and/or French (*), with a good command of the other. Knowledge of other EU languages would be an advantage.

Competencies

Find out more about EIB core competencies here

(*) Unless stated explicitly as a required qualification, a good command of French is not a pre-requisite for hire. As both English and French are however official working languages of the EIB, proficiency in both languages is a pre-requisite for your future career development. Any language clause in your contract must be fulfilled in order for you to be eligible for a promotion (either via the annual appraisal cycle or via an internal selection process). Proficiency is understood to mean the attainment of level 5 of the Inter Institutional language courses, corresponding to B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL). The Bank offers appropriate training support.

We are an equal opportunities employer, who believes that diversity is good for our people and our business. We encourage all suitably qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation/identity, disability or neurodiversity.

Applicants with specific needs are encouraged to request reasonable accommodations at any stage during the recruitment process. Please contact the EIB Recruitment team Jobs@eib.org who will ensure that your request is handled.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group. In case of selection for the position you agree to comply with all measures (policies, controls, document classification and management) implemented by the EIB Group to prevent unauthorised disclosure of any information or any damage to the EIB Group reputation.

Deadline for applications:This is an open campaign to consecutively fill open positions. The campaign will remain open until the positions are filled. Applications will be reviewed in order of receipt

jobs_results.title: Cybersecurity Lead Architect (f/m/d) Cloud
jobs_results.description:
Knowledge for the world of tomorrow.

In your new role you are a strategic partner for Siemens IT and other corporate units and guide them to implement security by design and by default in new and enhanced services. Both enables IT and cybersecurity to drive and support the Siemens strategy to drive digitalization and be ready for new business models. Focusing on market-leading IT platforms, the architect ensures that the digital security is an integral part of the entire business implementation, maintaining the business’s quality attributes such as confidentiality, integrity, availability and accountability for transactions processed before and after the launch of Zero Trust.

Are you creative in finding solutions for today tomorrow and ready to improve security for Siemens worldwide?

If yes, we have the budget and are ready for your application.

As Cybersecurity Platform Architect you will:
• Design an innovative security architecture for the complete digitalization stack to... integrate security relevant topics into the business architecture
• Take important decisions regarding the fundamental technological directions of cybersecurity elements
• Be an inspiring leader in the area of cybersecurity to communicate the architecture vision to the senior management and the entire organization
• Lead, guide, coach and motivate researchers, architects, developers, operators and system engineers over the entire platform lifetime.
• Monitor the cybersecurity market regarding emerging technologies, digital trends and upcoming cyber threats and take respective decisions
• Spark ideas in and beyond CYS, work and collaborate seamlessly across hierarchy levels.

To effectively act in this role:
• Master´s degree in computer science and/or Cybersecurity or equivalent experience
• Long-term experience in Cybersecurity Architecture with a clear focus on cloud
• For this position you need a deep technical foundation in Cloud in the areas of migration, technology, system operation
• A certification as Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) is a plus
• You possess cross platform know-how (technical foundation) and interfaces to other cybersecurity services
• As a good international teammate your like to work across hierarchies and organizations and think innovatively. You like to present and speak in public about innovations and ideas
• You have the ability to learn quickly and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving, growing, and multifaceted environment characterizes you

What we offer.
• 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard
• Attractive remuneration package
• Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth
• A variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family
• Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG
• Find more benefits here

Individual benefits are adapted to meet local legal regulations, the requirements of different job profiles, locations, and individual preferences.

Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens!

As an equal-opportunity employer we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities. We will ensure that you are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

www.siemens.com/careers - if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.

FAQ - if you need further information on the application process
